Miner:
[color=ebeb00]Miners[/color] extract [color=01e700]Minerals[/color] from any asteroid in range. [color=01e700]Minerals[/color] are needed to [color=00dfdf]construct structures, ships and missiles[/color]. Miners can be upgraded to increase their efficiency. 
Connection Limit: 1 Node
Solar:
[color=ebeb00]Solar Stations[/color] collect light from the sun and convert it into [color=00dfdf]Energy[/color], which is needed to [color=00dfdf]construct and power your structures[/color]. They can be upgraded several times to improve their efficiency. THEY ALSO ACT as your only battery early game to store energy.  
Connection Limit: 2 Nodes
Relay:
[color=ebeb00]Energy Relays[/color] are used to [color=00dfdf]transport Energy from Solar Stations and Energy Stores to all other structures[/color]. They do this by reflecting and refracting light. They are cheap to make, but weak. 
Connection Limit: 5 Nodes
Repair_Station:
[color=ebeb00]Repair Stations[/color] [color=00dfdf]repair structures[/color] within their radius. 
Connection Limit: 3 Nodes
Battery:
[color=ebeb00]Batteries[/color] act as [color=00dfdf]Energy storage[/color]. They increase the [color=00dfdf]maximum Energy[/color] of the net they are attached to. A net is everything connected to the tower, even indirectly. 
Connection Limit: 2 Nodes
Laser:
The [color=ebeb00]Laser[/color] has 3 modes. The [color=00dfdf]Pulsar[/color] fires short bursts that do minimal damage. The [color=00dfdf]Thel[/color] fires powerful, sustained beams. The [color=00dfdf]Basic[/color] is a standard laser with no special properties. 
Connection Limit: 1 Nodes
Missile_Launcher:
[color=ebeb00]Missile Launchers[/color] [color=00dfdf]fire missiles at enemies[/color], but the missiles consume [color=01e700]Minerals[/color].
Connection Limit: 1 Node
